EC4: systemic disorders such as diabetes [OR], rheumatoid arthritis [OR], haematological diseases [OR] (coagulopathy), severe cardiovascular diseases [OR], infections [OR], immunodepression;
EC5: patients in therapy with anticoagulants [OR] or antiaggregants;
EC6: use of NSAIDs in the 5 days before blood donation;
EC7: patients with Hb [OR] values < 11 g/dl and platelet values < 150,000/mmc.
